name: dns-tools
description: DNS and WHOIS diagnostics via DNS-over-HTTPS (Google) and RDAP. Resolve records (A/AAAA/MX/TXT/NS/CNAME/SOA/CAA), do reverse PTR lookups, inspect mail deliverability records (MX, SPF, DMARC), and look up domain registration/expiry with RDAP. Keyless — no credentials required.
author: Buildersoft LLC

tools.name: dns.lookup
tools.description: Resolve DNS records for a hostname over DNS-over-HTTPS. Returns the answer records with their data and TTLs.

tools.name: dns.reverse
tools.description: Reverse DNS (PTR) lookup for an IPv4 or IPv6 address. Returns the hostname(s) the address maps to.

tools.name: dns.mail_records
tools.description: Fetch a domain's mail deliverability records: MX servers (sorted by preference), the SPF policy (from TXT), and the DMARC policy (from _dmarc TXT).

tools.name: dns.whois
tools.description: Look up domain registration details via RDAP (the modern WHOIS): registrar, status, nameservers, and registration/expiration dates.

domain.description: Domain to look up, e.g. example.com
